_comment: Watchlist for the daily source check (tools/law-watch.mjs).
These are the PRIMARY statute pages behind the rules Amparo prints.
The job does NOT re-verify the law — no script can do that. It detects when
a source page's text CHANGES, which is the signal that a human needs to
re-read it. 'anchor' is a string that must appear in the page; the hash is
taken from a window around it so page furniture (ads, timestamps, nav)
URLs must point at CURRENT law, never a year-pinned snapshot (e.g. /codes/texas/2023/...) — a frozen year can never change, which would silently defeat the whole purpose of this watch.
All four sit on codes.findlaw.com. Justia 403s this runner under any load; if FindLaw ever starts blocking too, the job reports 'unreachable' (inconclusive) rather than raising a false alarm.
